name: Trinity College Dublin
summary: Dublin city-centre university founded in 1592; 121 undergraduate courses through CAO; its entry rule asks for English, Maths and a second language.

ib.text: 3 HL at 5 and 3 SL at 4 in one sitting, including English (SL 4), Maths and another language. Stricter courses: Mathematics needs HL Maths 6, Engineering HL Maths 5; Medicine HL 6 and 5 in two sciences.

notes: Medicine (TR051) is restricted: you sit HPAT-Ireland in your year of entry, and IB applicants need HL 6 and 5 in two of Physics, Chemistry and Biology.
The Bachelor in Acting is not on CAO: you apply through The Lir Academy by early February and audition between November and March.
Both IB maths courses are accepted, but for maths-intensive courses Trinity strongly recommends HL Maths: Analysis and Approaches.
